jobs.title: Senior FP&A Manager
jobs.description:
Introduction to Demandbase:

Demandbase is the only pipeline AI platform that empowers GTM teams to automate growth at scale. With a unified view of data, insights, actions, and outcomes, B2B enterprises can seamlessly align and execute their account-based GTM strategies with confidence. Thousands of businesses trust Demandbase to maximize revenue, minimize waste, and consolidate their data and tech stacks – all in one platform. 

As a company, we’re as committed to growing careers as we are to building world-class technology. We invest heavily in people, our culture, and the community around us. We have also continuously been recognized as One of The Best Places To Work in the San Francisco Bay Area by Fortune, and One of The 60 Best Companies To Sell For by Selling Power. Our offices are located in San Francisco, New York, Austin, Seattle, India, and the United Kingdom. 


ABOUT THE ROLE

Demandbase is seeking an experienced Senior FP&A Manager based in the US to join our dynamic finance team. This role is ideal for a strong financial partner with deep experience supporting engineering or technical organizations, and a background in corporate budgeting and SaaS performance drivers.

Reporting to the VP Finance, you will serve as the dedicated FP&A business partner to our Engineering organization, owning forecasting, headcount planning, and spend analysis for the function. You will also support Demandbase's corporate FP&A processes — including company-wide budgeting, long-range planning, rolling forecasts, and board-level reporting — as needed. You will work cross-functionally with finance and engineering leaders to deliver actionable insights that drive sustainable growth, efficiency, and sound decision-making.

 
 


WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

This role is primarily focused on Engineering business partnering, with some support of Corporate FP&A processes as needed.




BUSINESS PARTNERING

 - Serve as a strategic finance partner to Engineering leadership, owning headcount planning, COGS and opex forecasting, and cost center management.

 - Partner with Engineering leadership on key spend drivers — such as capitalized software costs, infrastructure/cloud spend, or resourcing trade-offs — depending on the function supported.

 - Develop and drive product-level P&Ls, giving Engineering and Product leadership clear visibility into profitability, cost allocation, and margin drivers by product line.

 - Define and monitor key operating metrics, connect them to financial outcomes, and proactively surface trends, risks, and opportunities for leadership.

 - Own and diagnosing root-cause drivers behind margin performance and flagging risks to leadership.




CORPORATE FP&A

 - Support the annual budgeting process, rolling forecasts, and long-range strategic plan across business units.

 - Partner with the VP of Finance to prepare materials for the Board of Directors, Investor Relations, and other financial stakeholders.


WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 - Minimum 5-7 years of experience in FP&A, financial planning, ideally within a technology or SaaS company.

 - Education: Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field. MBA or CPA a plus.

 - Demonstrated experience independently owning complex FP&A processes and serving as a trusted finance business partner to an engineering or technical organization, including headcount planning, opex forecasting, and cost driver analysis; exposure to corporate-level FP&A processes (budgeting, forecasting, Board reporting) a plus.

 - Communication: Strong communication and presentation skills; comfortable working with both finance leadership and functional stakeholders.

 - Tooling Expertise: Proficiency with financial planning platforms such as NetSuite, Workday Adaptive Planning, and advanced Google Sheets modeling.

 - Proficient in SaaS business models and key metrics (e.g., ARR, CAC, margin structure).

 - Self-starter with strong attention to detail; able to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

 - Collaborative mindset with strong business judgment and curiosity; motivated to be a trusted finance partner across the organization.



Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Demandbase

At Demandbase, we believe in creating a workplace culture that values and celebrates diversity in all its forms. We recognize that everyone brings unique experiences, perspectives, and identities to the table, and we are committed to building a community where everyone feels valued, respected, and supported. Discrimination of any kind is not tolerated, and we strive to ensure that every individual has an equal opportunity to succeed and grow, regardless of their gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, race, ethnicity, background, marital status, genetic information, education level, veteran status, national origin, or any other protected status. We do not automatically disqualify applicants with criminal records and will consider each applicant on a case-by-case basis.

We recognize that not all candidates will have every skill or qualification listed in this job description. If you feel you have the level of experience to be successful in the role, we encourage you to apply!

We acknowledge that true diversity and inclusion requires ongoing effort, and we are committed to doing the work required to make our workplace a safe and equitable space for all. Join us in building a community where we can learn from each other, celebrate our differences, and work together.

Unsolicited Submissions

At Demandbase, we value thoughtful partnerships and direct connections with candidates. We’re not accepting unsolicited resumes or outreach from third-party recruiting agencies. Any unsolicited submissions will not be reviewed, and no fees will be paid.

About The Role

We're looking for a Sr. Customer Operations Manager to serve as the operational and analytical backbone of our Customer Experience organization. This role owns the systems, processes, and insights that power our Customer Success (CS), Professional Services (PS), and Growth/Account Development (GAD) teams — from platform administration to revenue-critical forecasting models. The ideal candidate combines hands-on systems expertise with strong analytical rigor and the business acumen to translate raw data into decisions that shape revenue strategy.

What You'll Do

 - Serve as primary administrator for ChurnZero, including platform configuration, health scoring, automation workflows, and digital touch program execution

 - Administer Rocketlane for implementation and onboarding project tracking, ensuring data integrity and adoption across PS teams

 - Strategize and support the Growth Account Teams as it pertains to Reporting, Account Plans and Management of their book of business

 - Manage system enhancement requests with your RevOps partners who own and maintains other GTM systems (SFDC, Gong, Worktao,etc)

 - Establish and maintain customer digital touch motion (automation of plays, optimizations, updates, etc)

 - Develop new At Risk signals and automations for Account teams

 - Be a data steward in our customer data hygiene in CRM (Salesforce) & ChurnZero

 - Optimize territory and account assignment logic across CS, PS, and GAD teams

 - Drive key insights in churn analysis to identify risk patterns and inform proactive retention strategies

 - Model commission structures and expansion forecasts spanning the full customer portfolio

 - Develop performance KPIs and quarterly forecasting models for Growth and Renewals functions

 - Build and maintain financial reporting, account management dashboards, and proactive insights used across CX and GAD leadership

 - Model customer whitespace analysis to surface expansion opportunities, translating raw account data into actionable growth signals for GADs

 - Identify, design, and implement AI-driven automations to improve operational efficiency across the customer lifecycle

 - Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to scale automation initiatives beyond manual, repetitive workflows

 - Model Professional Service Capacity & metrics around project utilization and areas of optimization

What We're Looking For

 - 5-7 years of experience in RevOps, CS Ops, Sales Ops, or a related operations function, ideally within B2B SaaS

 - Direct technical administrative experience with ChurnZero, Rocketlane, or Gong (or comparable platforms in each category)

 - Strong proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets; working knowledge of SQL and/or BI tools (Tableau, Looker, Power BI)

 - Demonstrated experience building forecasting models, or portfolio-level analytics

 - Proven ability to partner cross-functionally with CS, PS, and Sales/GAD teams

 - Experience with Salesforce or an equivalent CRM

 - Familiarity with AI/automation tooling for operational workflows

 - Background supporting post-sale revenue motions

 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail

 - Ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable recommendations

 - Comfortable operating in ambiguity and building process where none exists

 - Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional communication skills

 - Self-directed with strong project management capabilities across multiple concurrent workstreams

Benefits

Our benefits include Group Medical, Personal Accident, and Term Life Insurance for comprehensive protection. Preventive healthcare covers dental, vision, and OPD needs, complemented by strong mental health support. We also provide a fitness benefit, car lease policy, and gratuity for long-term financial well-being.

jobs.title: Senior Customer Lifecycle Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Introduction to Demandbase:

Demandbase is the only pipeline AI platform that empowers GTM teams to automate growth at scale. With a unified view of data, insights, actions, and outcomes, B2B enterprises can seamlessly align and execute their account-based GTM strategies with confidence. Our offices are located in San Francisco, New York, Austin, Seattle, India, and the United Kingdom. 


ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Senior Marketing Manager to build and execute programs that engage Demandbase customers throughout their lifecycle and drive product adoption, expansion, and retention.

This is a senior individual contributor role that sits at the intersection of Customer Marketing, Customer Experience, Product, Product Marketing, Sales, and Professional Services. You’ll own integrated customer campaigns, scaled communications, and triggered lifecycle programs designed around the moments that matter most in the customer journey.

This is a builder role. You’ll be creating new programs, frameworks, and ways of working, often without an established playbook. We’re looking for someone who is comfortable navigating ambiguity, moving quickly in a dynamic environment, and bringing structure to cross-functional challenges.

In the near term, a key priority for this role will be driving Demandbase AI (DBAI) adoption, building targeted campaigns utilizing multiple channels that move customers from awareness and education to product usage and ongoing engagement.




WHAT YOU’LL DO


INTEGRATED CUSTOMER CAMPAIGNS

 - Develop and execute integrated campaigns that drive product adoption, expansion, and customer engagement across lifecycle touchpoints.

 - Lead near-term campaigns focused on DBAI adoption, developing audience strategies, messaging, offers, and journeys that encourage customers to discover and use Demandbase AI.

 - Build and execute land-and-expand campaigns that help Demandbase grow within enterprise customers by identifying and engaging new business units, child accounts, buying groups, and stakeholders beyond the existing customer footprint.

 - Partner with Sales and Customer Experience to develop account-based expansion plays that combine scaled marketing programs with personalized account team outreach.

 - Partner with Product Marketing on product launches and translate launches into customer-facing campaigns that drive awareness, education, adoption, and continued usage.

 - Build campaigns across channels including email, in-product experiences, customer events and user groups, webinars, educational content, and Sales/CS outreach.

 - Measure campaign performance and use engagement, product adoption, and expansion signals to continuously optimize programs.


CUSTOMER LIFECYCLE PROGRAMS

 - Map the customer journey and identify key moments that matter where scaled marketing programs can improve the customer experience and business outcomes.

 - Partner with Customer Experience, Product, Sales, and Professional Services to build triggered lifecycle programs based on customer behavior, lifecycle stage, and product usage.

 - Develop programs for moments such as customer welcome and onboarding, new-user activation, product adoption, renewal preparation, expansion opportunities, and re-engagement.

 - Develop differentiated engagement strategies based on customer persona and role, from individual users and practitioners to executive stakeholders.

 - Build repeatable programs that complement high-touch Customer Success engagement and allow Demandbase to deliver a more personalized customer experience at scale.


CUSTOMER COMMUNICATIONS, SEGMENTATION & DATABASE MANAGEMENT

 - Own the strategy and execution of scaled customer communications, creating a coordinated approach across Marketo, ChurnZero, Pendo, and other customer-facing channels.

 - Develop a customer segmentation and activation framework that connects customer data and capabilities across platforms, determining how account attributes, product usage, lifecycle stage, persona, and behavioral signals inform who we communicate with, when, and through which channel.

 - Partner with Revenue Operations, Customer Experience, Product, and other teams to bridge fragmented customer data and tools and establish clear audience governance around targeting, suppression, frequency, and prioritization.

 - Own the customer communications calendar and work cross-functionally to identify overlaps, gaps, and opportunities across communications originating from Marketing, Product, Customer Experience, and other teams.

 - Serve as a customer communications steward, establishing templates and editorial standards that ensure scaled communications meet a high bar for brand voice, tone, content quality, relevance, and overall customer experience.

 - Plan and execute recurring customer communications, including newsletters, product communications, customer education, and event promotion.




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR


EXPERIENCE & MARKETING EXPERTISE

 - 7-10 years of experience in lifecycle marketing, customer marketing, integrated campaigns, CRM marketing, or a related discipline, ideally within B2B SaaS.

 - Demonstrated experience building integrated campaigns tied to measurable outcomes such as product adoption, expansion, engagement, or retention.

 - Experience developing account-based or expansion campaigns within enterprise accounts, including engaging multiple personas, buying groups, or business units. Familiarity with Demandbase One is a huge plus.

 - Strong understanding of the B2B SaaS customer journey and experience partnering across Marketing, Customer Success, Product, Sales, and Operations.

 - Excellent editorial judgment and a strong understanding of brand, voice, tone, and content quality, with the ability to turn product concepts into clear and compelling customer communications.

 - Strong cross-functional leadership skills and the ability to independently bring structure, strategy, and momentum to programs involving multiple teams and stakeholders.


TECHNICAL & AI FLUENCY

 - Hands-on experience with Marketo or similar marketing automation platforms, with a strong understanding of segmentation, targeting, database management, and campaign operations. Experience with platforms such as ChurnZero and Pendo is a plus.

 - Experience working across multiple customer data sources and activation platforms to build practical audience segmentation and triggered lifecycle programs.

 - Comfortable using AI as part of the day-to-day marketing workflow to improve efficiency, personalization, content development, analysis, and campaign execution.

 - Experience marketing or driving adoption of AI-powered products or features is a plus, including the ability to translate AI capabilities into practical customer use cases and value.

 - Analytical mindset and comfort using campaign, customer, and product usage data to identify opportunities, develop audiences, and measure impact.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

You’ll help Demandbase create a more connected customer journey: customers receive the right communication at the right moment, discover and adopt more of the platform, and have clear pathways to deepen and expand their relationship with Demandbase. You’ll build scalable lifecycle and expansion programs that help us grow within existing customers while creating a more relevant, personalized customer experience.




BENEFITS:

Our benefits include options for up to 100% paid Medical, Dental, and Vision premiums for you and your entire family, $1,000 personal development stipend, flexible PTO policy, no internal meeting Fridays, Modern Health mental wellness platform, Headspace, Ginger, and 13 paid holidays and 2 additional weeks where all Demandbase employees take off (week of July 4th and Thanksgiving). Plus 401(k), short-term/long-term disability, life insurance, and all those good things.
